impact: Weak crypto prices weigh on HOOD trading revenue and on COIN; a rebound would likely need tech risk appetite to recover after Nvidia.
summary: Bitcoin traded around $64,600 on Tuesday, up about 0.4% on the day but down about 13% over seven days, with Ether near $1,828. The slide has tracked the broader risk-off move in tech ahead of Nvidia's results.
title: Bitcoin near $64,600, down about 13% in a week
